BLOCKING — F24 (P1, OPEN, NEW, raised by the twelfth PR #325 Copilot review of HEAD a20c5b50, AFTER the 3-cycle plan-review budget was exhausted).

DEFECT: this task's DoD says "Add `.autoharness/sessions/` to the gitignore template." THERE IS NO GITIGNORE TEMPLATE IN THIS REPOSITORY. Verified: `templates/` contains no `*gitignore*` artifact of any kind, and the root `.gitignore` covers only this dogfood checkout, not generated workspaces. Target-workspace ignore rules are handled procedurally by `.github/skills/install-harness/SKILL.md` (Step 3.2b / the installed-artifact table), which CONFIRMS an existing workspace `.gitignore` ignores `.env.local` rather than rendering a template.

TWO CONSEQUENCES:
(1) UNSATISFIABLE-BY-VACUITY. The criterion can be "met" by searching for an artifact that does not exist and finding nothing to change. Same defect class as F17 and F23 — acceptance criteria that cannot be discharged as written — except this one fails SILENTLY rather than obviously, which makes it worse: nothing forces the implementer to notice.
(2) IT FALSIFIES AN H6 HARDENING PROPERTY. This same task asserts the journal is "GITIGNORED LOCAL OPERATIONAL STATE" and leans on that to argue authority containment (journal is not a backlog artifact, must not be read by crash-resumption). If nothing installs the ignore rule into generated workspaces, that property is simply UNTRUE there: every supervised session writes per-session JSONL under `<workspace>/.autoharness/sessions/` and git tracks it. The journal is redacted at the 118.004-T choke point, so this is not a direct secret leak, but it does mean operational session state gets committed to every consumer repository, and a documented hardening guarantee is unbacked.

RESOLUTION (operator decision; Stage adopted none): assign the ignore rule to the surfaces that actually install workspace files — the install-harness skill and the tuner — rather than to a nonexistent template, and require a REAL test: `git check-ignore` for `.autoharness/sessions/...` inside a disposable target workspace. That test is what converts this from a claim into a verified property. Note this likely moves scope OUT of 119.005-T (S2, supervise/journal.py) and INTO the installer surfaces, which is a shipment-boundary question, not a wording fix — hence P1 and hence an operator decision.

STAGE ADOPTED NO RESOLUTION and changed no dependency edge. Gates 128-S. Detail: docs/reviews/2026-08-09-copilot-cli-supervisor-control-plane-review.md (Cycle 4, twelfth Copilot pass).
